summary: Sunrise Communications AG filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 interim financial results via an ad hoc announcement. The filing reports stable revenue (+0.1% YoY), increased Adjusted EBITDAaL (+2.5% YoY), and confirms 2026 guidance including a planned dividend of CHF 3.49 per Class A share and CHF 0.35 per Class B share. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. This is a routine earnings update.
